In this anime sequence, 1. <C01>(young man, dark hair, black suit, red tie) stands alone in a rooftop garden at night with neon skyline, red lanterns, and distant fireworks, 2. <C02>(young woman, blue hair, school uniform, white ribbon) watches him from the opposite side of the rooftop near potted plants and glowing festival lights, 3. <C01> and <C02> walk together under hanging lanterns as sparks from fireworks drift across the sky, 4. <C02> holds a small blue charm while neon reflections shimmer on the wet rooftop tiles, 5. <C01> opens a glass door to a quiet stairwell with red emergency lights and soft shadows, 6. <C01> and <C02> descend the stairs slowly while festival music and fireworks continue outside, 7. <C01> and <C02> pause in a rainy alley beside a vending machine with colorful signs and puddle reflections, 8. <C01> and <C02> stand together at sunrise on the rooftop as the lanterns fade and the city becomes quiet.
